checks.result: A resident can register through the interface and reach the dashboard.
Required fields show inline errors and the first invalid field receives focus.
Review-to-edit retains form data and shows the revised location.
Submission confirms a reference and opens the resident timeline.
Anonymous reporter name and mobile are hidden in staff detail.
A staff update appears on the resident timeline after refresh.
Resolution preserves all three timeline entries.
Search and status filters return the matching report or an empty state.
390px mobile detail layout has no horizontal overflow.
GPS denial leaves manual location entry available.
Network failure keeps the report draft available for correction and retry.
No uncaught browser JavaScript errors during the tested flow.
Sign-out returns to sign-in and permits resident-to-staff switching in the same browser.
